g.text: HERO: backdrop image → trailer autoplays muted after ~2 s
(tap = pause/resume trailer, no chrome; paused/ended → backdrop)
single mute glyph, bottom-right, the only control over the hero
TITLE LOGO (56–120 pt) or bold title text
series: 'Download Season 1'; tap while active = Pause / Cancel; layout never moves
→ Not for Me / I Like This / Love This
Synopsis, 3–4 lines, plain text (tagline italic above it when present)
hidden until stream sources are known; add-on names as plain small text, never logos
Black boxes = current OpenStream structure (iPhone, 393 pt wide). Red italics = rules already agreed.
Import into Figma: File → Import (or drag the .svg onto the canvas); every block is a named layer.
Edit freely and send the exported frame back; I will translate it to SwiftUI.
title baseline aligned with the toolbar icons; no explainer text; no scroll indicator
exactly 10, in order, rank badge in poster corner, no error card
provider as plain text, no wordmark; Movies/Shows split
PINNED PLAYER (stock controls, 16:9, stays while browsing)
lineup category tabs (Favorites first); no provider-group tabs; no channel-count footer
Premier Guide numbering; East feeds only; 24/7 and NO EVENT filler hidden; DirecTV-style grid, done better
Bonjour, resolved within 3 s, name + host:port, no Find Servers button
after sign-in: share list from the server → pick one → saved; errors name the reason (auth vs unreachable)
